titre: Carnet de commandes mondial de navires
sous_titre: Part de la flotte en service, en %, fin novembre 2024 et fin novembre 2025

Vraquiers.texte: The bulk carrier orderbook stood at 117M dwt at the end of November, equivalent to around 11% of the active fleet

Pétroliers.texte: the orderbook reached 119M dwt, accounting for 17% of the existing fleet

Porte-conteneurs.texte: orderbook now totals 11M TEU, corresponding to around 33% of the active fleet, compared with 26% in the same period last year
